<div class="card-body">
'''Molator''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">モレイトア</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">場の自分の側に配備する。戦闘の際、能力値があるカードを何枚か選ぶ。カード一枚につき合計戦闘力に＋１の修正を得る。それぞれに１フォースを消費する。この効果のために使ったカードの能力値は、運命数を引く際に数えない。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デジャリック・ホロゲームに登場する、オルデランの伝説上の動物。伝承によれば、モレイトアは強力な魔力を持ち、オルデラン諸国の王や王女を護衛したという。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Molator.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. During battle, choose some cards with ability. For each card, gain a +1 adjustment to total power. Use 1 Force for each. The ability of cards used for this effect does not count when drawing destiny.

'''Lore:''' A legendary animal of Alderaan appearing in the dejarik hologame. According to tradition, molators possessed powerful magic and guarded the kings and princesses of Alderaan's nations.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card describes choosing cards with ability and gaining +1 power per card; the English describes gaining +1 for each unit of ability present. The Japanese lore describes kings and princesses; the English says kings and queens.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Molator]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].
